definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (entry 4.128) and §2023:3.125 define national coded character set in the same words. Which alphabets define one is fixed by §2002:12.2.6.3 (Table 7), whose rows equal the 2023 Table 6; the rule governs the same alphabet-names. Scope and evidence unchanged.

definition-dropped.answer: 2002 defines 'character' in four senses (4.26-4.29) and 'coded character set' (4.40, after ISO/IEC 10646-1); 2023 leaves them undefined. The rule names an alphabet that defines a national coded character set, a property Table 7 assigns per ALPHABET operand (§2002:12.2.6.3); no sense of 'character' changes which alphabet qualifies.
